incident: Airlock v2.3.5 declared the SOVARA LiteLLM v2.3 provider-admission workflow active and OIDC-admitted, while Phoenix Emergency Execution Freeze still omitted it from the hard-coded keep-active and required-readback sets. Every main push therefore disabled the admitted provider gateway, and a post-repair provider trigger produced no provider workflow run.
repair: add the provider gateway to Phoenix keep-active matching
add it to required workflow readback and re-enable convergence
dispatch it once when Phoenix has newly re-enabled it
retain repository-read-only provider workflow permissions and artifact-only evidence
truth_boundary: The source repair restores execution-plane alignment. It does not prove Google WIF, provider credentials, semantic inference, LiteLLM deployment, rollback, soak, or FULLY_ESTABLISHED status. The newly dispatched provider run and immutable artifacts remain the only provider-stage evidence.
